report:
Fresh review of the complete diagnostic_locations claim, all three ordinary implementation entries and all eight associated tests. Additional dependencies captured: span representation/composition, logical path normalization and annotation parsing/applicability. No TODO/N/A evidence is present. No source edits, build or tests run in this review; conclusions are from source/assertion inspection. One out-of-bounds source capture request was retried successfully using the whole file.

Sage locations: diagnostic.rs freezes Diagnostic::span separately from labels and notes. Span::resolve composes relative offsets against the owning item. Snapshot location conversion follows BangMacro invocation and Derive source-item ancestry until reaching the actual fixture source file, including nested generated sources; generated buffers are not exposed as fixture filenames. SourceLocation::lines counts newlines before start and before end-1 for a nonempty range, or before start for an empty range. Thus nonempty ranges use half-open intersection, a zero-width position at a line start belongs to that line, and EOF uses the final source line, including a trailing empty line. Snapshot rendering keeps labels and recursively rendered notes, but matching uses only the separate primary locations. Prefixing normalizes fixture-relative paths without changing text.

observe.rs builds eligibility using applicable marker severity, exact logical filename and any intersecting primary location. It never parses rendered diagnostics or consults labels/notes for edges. Matching assigns by diagnostic index, so several eligible lines/ancestry locations still describe one event; locationless events remain unmatched and fail. This separates diagnostic rendering choices, including primary-styled labels, from eligibility.

rustc.rs parses structured top-level JSON and selects only spans whose is_primary flag is true. For each selected span it walks recursive expansion.span ancestry, accepting relative paths in the fixture file map and validating byte offsets/character boundaries. Invocation spans need not themselves have is_primary true once reached through ancestry. Locations share SourceLocation::lines, so empty invocation and primary spans follow the same positional rule. Child notes/help and secondary spans do not add locations/events. Every ordinary top-level error/warning appends one event without message deduplication. Only spanless, uncoded recognized count-summary forms and failure-note presentation are omitted; other spanless errors/warnings remain unmatched. A source-located diagnostic with summary-like text is retained.

All tests assessed: empty_spans_match_positions_including_eof checks an empty span at the second line's start and trailing-newline EOF through Sage matching. labels_and_notes_do_not_supply_matching_locations rejects matching at a primary-styled label/note location while accepting the true primary and retaining label/note rendering. empty_primary_and_nested_invocation_spans_keep_position_lines covers midline, line start, EOF without newline and EOF with newline for both direct and nested invocation spans; each matches one marker and rejects two, checking event identity. nested_macro_errors_match_invocations_and_multiple_errors_need_multiple_markers runs the real pinned-compiler helper for nested macros and same-line multiple errors. only_spanless_summaries_and_failure_notes_are_presentation checks summary/failure-note filtering, retention and rejection of arbitrary spanless errors and warnings, and retention plus warning-only matching of located summary-like text. primary_spans_and_ancestry_match_but_labels_and_children_do_not asserts exact extracted primary/ancestry line numbers, excludes a secondary span and child event, preserves duplicate top-level events and rejects locationless ones. invalid_source_reaches_sage supplies a real multiline primary body mismatch matching a marker on an intersected line while retaining detailed rendering. macro_generated_errors_match_the_invocation supplies a generated body mismatch and asserts the invocation-based Sage snapshot through normal compilation. The visible test helpers create the stated source offsets and invoke the production parser/checker or matcher. Source inspection plus these assertions accounts for logical location, severity, empty spans, ancestry, event count, presentation exclusions and unmatched failures. No concrete defect or required edit found.
